facts.fact: The Mzalendo Trust policy brief names the National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032; the brief gives no event date, so its published date, 2026-01-01, is used, and it does not say whether the plan's text is public.

The brief says the National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032 targets digitalising 80% of government services and deploying 100,000 km of fibre optic infrastructure, and states no cost; the published date, 2026-01-01, is used.

note: The brief gives two targets of the Master Plan but does not describe whether it spans the economy and the state, so class is left empty.
